# TheBernese.org

> A comprehensive resource for Bernese Mountain Dog owners, prospective buyers, and breed enthusiasts covering breed information, care, training, health, and responsible breeding practices.

TheBernese.org provides authoritative guidance on Bernese Mountain Dogs, a Swiss Alpine breed with a rich history. The site emphasizes responsible ownership, ethical breeding, and the health and wellness of these large, family-oriented dogs.

## Key Topics

- Bernese Mountain Dog
- Breed characteristics
- Puppy care and feeding
- Training and obedience
- Health and wellness
- Exercise requirements
- Responsible breeding
- Breeder selection
- Rescue and adoption
- Grooming
- Separation anxiety
- Growth and development
- Swiss Alps heritage
- AKC breed standard
- Berner-Garde Foundation

## Breed Overview & Guide

- [Bernese Mountain Dog Breed Info & Guide](https://thebernese.org/bernese-mountain-dogs): Comprehensive guide to Bernese Mountain Dog traits, history, care, and temperament.
- [Berner-Garde Foundation: Extending Bernese Lifespans](https://thebernese.org/berner-garde-foundation): Health research foundation extending Bernese Mountain Dog lifespan through genetics.

## Puppy Care & Nutrition

- [Bernese Mountain Dog Puppy Feeding Guide](https://thebernese.org/how-much-to-feed-bernese-puppy): Puppy feeding portions, growth-stage nutrition, and joint-health diet tips.
- [Bernese Mountain Dog Growth & Size Chart Guide](https://thebernese.org/bernese-mountain-dog-size-chart): Growth charts, weight guides, and size milestones for Bernese Mountain Dogs.

## Health, Care & Wellness

- [Bernese Mountain Dog Care & Wellness Guide](https://thebernese.org/care-wellness): Essential care, grooming, nutrition, and wellness guide for Bernese Mountain Dogs.
- [Bernese Mountain Dog Exercise Guide](https://thebernese.org/exercise): Daily exercise requirements and activity tips for Bernese Mountain Dogs.
- [Bernese Mountain Dog Separation Anxiety Explained](https://thebernese.org/separation-anxiety): Understanding separation anxiety in Bernese Mountain Dogs and training solutions.
- [Hiking with Bernese Mountain Dogs: The Ultimate Guide](https://thebernese.org/bernese-mountain-dog-hiking): Hiking guide with safety, conditioning, and gear tips for Bernese Mountain Dogs.

## Training & Behavior

- [Basic Obedience Training for Bernese Mountain Dog Puppies](https://thebernese.org/basic-obedience-training): Obedience commands and training techniques for Bernese Mountain Dog puppies.

## Responsible Breeding & Adoption

- [Questions to Ask a Bernese Breeder](https://thebernese.org/breeder-questions): Essential questions for selecting responsible Bernese Mountain Dog breeders.
- [Dog Breeder Red Flags: How to Spot a Bad Breeder](https://thebernese.org/dog-breeder-red-flags): Guide to identifying unethical breeders and red flags in puppy buying.
- [What is a Backyard Breeder? Reputable vs Backyard Breeders](https://thebernese.org/what-is-a-backyard-breeder): Comparison of backyard breeders versus reputable Bernese Mountain Dog breeders.
- [Adopt a Bernese Mountain Dog | Rescue & Rehome Guide](https://thebernese.org/bernese-mountain-dog-rescue): Guide to rescuing and adopting Bernese Mountain Dogs responsibly.

## Navigation & Resources

- [Site Map – TheBernese.org | Easy Navigation & Resources](https://thebernese.org/map): Site navigation map organizing all Bernese Mountain Dog resources and pages.
